about: Hand-written, synthetic texts for the crisis screen. `show: true` must show resources; `show: false` should stay quiet; `either` is acceptable both ways and isn't scored, so the screen isn't tuned to our own edge cases. Recall on `true` is the number that matters (docs/checkin/safety.md).
